LanguageData.MI_MorphineTolerance.label: morphine tolerance
LanguageData.MI_MorphineTolerance.description: A built-up tolerance to morphine. The more severe this tolerance is, the more morphine it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.MI_MorphineAddiction.label: morphine addiction
LanguageData.MI_MorphineAddiction.description: A chemical addiction to morphine. Long-term use of morphine has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of morphine, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
LanguageData.MI_KetamineTolerance.label: ketamine tolerance
LanguageData.MI_KetamineTolerance.description: A built-up tolerance to ketamine. The more severe this tolerance is, the more ketamine it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.MI_KetamineAddiction.label: ketamine addiction
LanguageData.MI_KetamineAddiction.description: A psychological dependence on ketamine. Chronic use has altered neurotransmitter systems involved in mood and cognition, creating a powerful craving for the dissociative state it provides. \nWithout ketamine, severe psychological withdrawal symptoms will manifest. However, prolonged abstinence will allow brain chemistry to gradually return to normal, resolving the addiction.
